title: How should tools and skills resolve relocated support paths?
question: How should tools and skills resolve relocated support paths?
answer:
V3-13: Every one of the 12 core skills resolves any project support path through workbench/manifest.json; a skill that does not touch support records remains behaviorally unchanged.
V3-12C: No. Genesis writes only v3 paths; Adoption and update recognize legacy inputs during a one-time migration, then the manifest becomes the sole path authority.
